heroDescription: The Localisation Hub brings together African National Societies committed to stronger, locally led humanitarian and development systems — through aligned leadership, shared vision, and coordinated action.
membershipDescription: Aligned leadership and coordinated action accelerating localisation across the continent.
steeringGroupDescription: The Alliance operates through a Steering Group of volunteer leaders from participating National Societies, providing strategic direction, coordination and oversight.
localisationHubDescription: Hosted by the Kenya Red Cross Society (KRCS), the Hub translates the Alliance's vision into practice through coordination, technical support, learning facilitation and project implementation — including the development and hosting of this platform.
digitalTransformationDesc: Building this peer-to-peer learning platform and supporting systems strengthening across African NSs.
impactMeasurementDesc: Financial Sustainability Impact Studies and a measurement framework tailored to African contexts.
capacityBuildingDesc: An NSD Working Group in Africa and peer-to-peer learning assessment tools.
fourPillarDescription: The Alliance's work is organised into four technical pillars, each led by a specific partner. The platform's resources, tools and updates are categorised by pillar colour for a consistent experience.
leadershipDesc: Building integrity, good governance and effective, transparent leadership.
branchDesc: Strengthening branch frameworks, plans and locally generated income.
resourceDesc: Diversifying income, including Workplace First Aid initiatives.
financeDesc: Core cost coverage, robust finance systems and long-term resilience.
indicatorDescription: The platform is designed to integrate the Alliance's financial sustainability indicators — from audited accounts to NSD plans and asset documentation.
sustainabilityDesc: Collaboration that endures beyond any single project.
financialSustainabilityDesc: Resource mobilisation, diversification and long-term resilience.
institutionalDevelopmentDesc: Strengthening leadership, governance and digital transformation.
knowledgeSharingDesc: Regional learning and documentation of developed tools.
ctaTitle: More than a project — a movement toward locally led humanitarian action.
